title: Use Stream Compression instead of Single-shot Compression in `BrotliEncoder`

timeline.body:
Motivation:
As per the current implementation, `BrotliEncoder` compress a `ByteBuf` in a single operation. This approach is good when we have small data set to work with. However, In the case of stream, there are multiple `ByteBuf`, and compressing each `ByteBuf` using the Single-shot method is the wrong approach.

Modification:
Use streaming compression.

Result:
Fixes #12909.

reply.body: That's on my list but I want to use reflection for now so we can ship the patch faster in SNAPSHOTS.

reply.body:
We cannot change `ByteBuf` where compressed data is written during encoding. Storing all compressed in one single buffer is not a solution here. 

Though, I am all ears for improving this.
There are ways where we don't have to use OutputStream at all but that requires modification in Brotli4j code a lot.
